camel_example: aliyun ecs RenewReservedInstances --region cn-hangzhou --AutoRenewPeriod 1 --AutoRenew true --Period 1 --ReservedInstanceId.1 'ecsri-2ze53qonjqxg7r0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --PeriodUnit Year
description_en: Renews one or more reserved instances. You can specify the purchase duration and auto-renewal attribute during renewal
description_zh: 本接口用于对一张或多张预留实例券进行续费，支持您在续费时设置购买时长和自动续费属性
kebab_example: aliyun ecs renew-reserved-instances --reserved-instance-id ecsri-2ze53qonjqxg7r0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --period 1 --period-unit Year --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --auto-renew true --auto-renew-period 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RenewReservedInstances

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the reserved instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
预留实例券所属的地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html获取最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The duration of the reserved instance.

<props="intl">Valid values: 1 and 3.</props>


<props="china">

If PeriodUnit is set to Year, valid values are 1, 3, and 5.

If PeriodUnit is set to Month, the valid value is 1.

</props>


Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
购买预留实例券的时长。

<props="intl">取值范围：1、3。</props>


<props="china">

当`PeriodUnit`为`Year`时，取值范围：1、3、5。

当`PeriodUnit`为`Month`时，取值范围：1。

</props>


默认值：1
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the duration of the reserved instance.

<props="intl">Valid values: Year.</props>

<props="intl">Default value: Year.</props>

<props="china">Valid values: Year and Month.</props>

<props="china">Default value: Month.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
购买预留实例券的时长单位。

<props="intl">取值范围：Year。</props>

<props="intl">默认值：Year。</props>

<props="china">取值范围：Year、Month。</props>

<props="china">默认值：Month。</props>
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal.

true: enables auto-renewal.
false: does not enable auto-renewal.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否要自动续费。

true：自动续费。
false：不自动续费。

默认值：false
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal period, in months. This parameter takes effect only when AutoRenew is set to true.

<props="intl">Valid values: 12 and 36. Default value: 12.</props>

<props="china">

If PeriodUnit is set to Month, valid values are 1, 12, 36, and 60. Default value: 1.

If PeriodUnit is set to Year, valid values are 12, 36, and 60. Default value: 12.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
每次自动续费的时长，单位为月。当参数AutoRenew取值为true时，该参数才生效。

<props="intl">取值范围：12，36。默认值为12。</props>

<props="china">

PeriodUnit=Month， 取值范围：1，12，36，60。默认值为1。

PeriodUnit=Year，取值范围：12，36，60。默认值为12。

</props>
parameters.name: auto_renew_period
